summary.en: Sites generated at build time, served as files, with behaviour added only where it is needed.

lead.en: Sites generated at build time, served as files, with behaviour added only where it is needed.

items.en: Pages are generated at build time, so the content is in the HTML for crawlers, readers without JavaScript and slow connections.
Fonts and icons are self-hosted; there are no third-party requests.
All text lives in one file per language. Adding a language needs no code change, and right-to-left languages are supported.
Forms post to an endpoint you choose, and show a clear disabled state until one is configured.
Status and evidence labels are first-class, so drafts are never presented as products.

body.en: A static-first approach is a poor fit for sites that need per-user content on every page. The studio will say so rather than force it.

text.en: Every claim on this site is dated, and every limit declared.
